purpose: Construct the blocked declarative representation of two Practice equation candidates while preserving the exact scientific decision set.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, two required keyed opaque inputs, ordered object population, canonical provenance, and exact six-reference decision set.
Preserve objects 062 and 091, all input and output identities, payloads, reservations, traceability, and scientific decisions.
Keep structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection available despite blocked evaluation.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer a validity threshold, adequacy predicate, collective coordination algorithm, equation method, or runtime type.
Do not add, remove, replace, or resolve decision references, and do not invent sequences, durations, progressions, effects, or partial successful results.

deferred.statement: Scientific evaluation is deferred to scientific review and scientific execution requires an external executor.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable blocked equation-candidate representation or a stable structured error.

constraints.statement: Both values are independently required under candidate status and remain opaque.

preconditions.statement: Inputs 006-1 and 006-2 and objects 062 and 091 are present in canonical documentary order.
The exact scientific decisions are TLC-SO-PRACTICE-062, TLC-SO-PRACTICE-091, TLC-SR-PRACTICE-061, TLC-SR-PRACTICE-090, TLC-HR-0048, and TLC-HR-0051.

postconditions.statement: The representation preserves both objects, both opaque payloads, source references, reservations, and all six decisions exactly.
Blocked scientific evaluation does not block successful structural representation.

invariants.statement: The exact decision set is neither shortened nor extended.
No threshold value, adequacy predicate, coordination procedure, runtime type, method, duration, progression, or effect is inferred.

steps: validate identities cardinality provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque values documentary order and blockers

partial_order.before: validate identities cardinality provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque values documentary order and blockers

prescription_basis: Exact blocker propagation, preservation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-006.
Source error id missing_required_input: input 006-1 or 006-2 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: a required value is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: an object or decision lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, order, provenance, or exact decision set differs from authority.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id scientific_decision_required: scientific evaluation is requested before the exact decisions are resolved.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: an undeclared predicate, algorithm, method, duration, progression, or effect is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the blocked declarative representation while preserving the exact decisions.
Do not infer validity or coordination semantics before future scientific authority.
Internal architecture remains free when all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Blocked scientific evaluation never invalidates an otherwise valid structural representation.
Decision identity, candidate status, scientific opacity, documentary order, and traceability cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, output, and decision identities
Exact ordered source and blocker collections

notes: Conformance is structural; validity and coordination science remain unresolved.
